results.title: Seven deaths in seven months: Daughter of Highway 17 crash victim calls for safety improvements
results.description: Seven people have died in crashes on Highway 17 in the first seven months of the year. Now, the daughter of one of those victims is calling on the province to make safety improvements she hopes would prevent another family from experiencing the same loss.
